# Coloring Page Maker

Coloring page maker: printable coloring pages of any subject, simple for kids or detailed mandalas for adults, generated ready to print.

## What it does
Name the subject and choose kids or adults. Claude tells you the price and creates a printable page.

**How the files are made:** each coloring page is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Image files in portrait; print at A4 or Letter.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install coloring-page-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Coloring Page Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/coloring-page/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each coloring page uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The coloring pages show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_coloring_page_models` | Models for coloring pages with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_coloring_page_cost` | Exact price of one coloring page before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_coloring_page` | Starts one coloring page in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_coloring_page` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A dinosaur in a jungle for kids"
- "A detailed mandala with roses for adults"
- "A unicorn castle coloring page"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the coloring page (the subject and whether it is for kids or adults) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
